name: veil_of_summer_duress_loses_its_target
note: Veil of Summer: 'You and permanents you control gain hexproof from blue and from black until end of turn.' On P1's turn P1 casts Duress (black) targeting P0 and keeps priority; P0 answers with Veil of Summer. Veil draws P0 a card (an opponent cast a black spell this turn) and gives P0 hexproof from black, so as Duress resolves its only target is illegal (CR 702.11d, 608.2b): it does not resolve, and P0 keeps the Spare Instant Duress would have taken. Red before 2026-11-13: player hexproof was never read, the third sentence did not compile, and Duress took the instant (P0's hand 1).
